Rate sheet for the Tallow & Finch Couriers parcel service
- Zone assignment: Zone 1 = postcodes 78000 to 94999; Zone 2 = postcodes 50000 to 77999; Zone 3 = postcodes 10000 to 49999 and postcodes 95000 to 99999 (both ends of every postcode range are included).
- Insurance, only when requested: 3 % of the declared value, at least CHF 2.00.
- No VAT or other tax is added to these prices.
- Fuel surcharge: 16.5 % of the base price.
- Labels can be printed at any of our 642 service points.
- Tracking updates by e-mail are included at no charge.
- Parcels that cannot be delivered are kept at the depot for 10 days.
- Parcels of 25 kg or more are not accepted.
- Oversize charge: CHF 26.80 if the longest side is 60 cm or more.
- Peak-season surcharge: CHF 2.10 per parcel handed over from 2026-11-11 to 2026-12-05, both dates included.
- Base prices (a weight exactly on a band limit belongs to the next band up):
   under 1 kg: Zone 1 CHF 6.80, Zone 2 CHF 9.65, Zone 3 CHF 11.33
   1 kg to under 2.5 kg: Zone 1 CHF 8.77, Zone 2 CHF 12.45, Zone 3 CHF 14.61
   2.5 kg to under 7 kg: Zone 1 CHF 10.07, Zone 2 CHF 14.29, Zone 3 CHF 16.77
   7 kg to under 15 kg: Zone 1 CHF 12.96, Zone 2 CHF 18.39, Zone 3 CHF 21.59
   15 kg to under 25 kg: Zone 1 CHF 16.45, Zone 2 CHF 23.35, Zone 3 CHF 27.41
- Chargeable weight: whichever is greater of the scale weight and the dimensional weight; dimensional weight in kg = L x W x H (all in cm) / 5000. The chargeable weight is rounded up to the next full kilogram before the band is looked up.
- Order of calculation: work out the chargeable weight; then look up the base price; then add the surcharges; then round.
- Rounding: no intermediate amount is rounded; only the amount due at the very end is rounded, to the nearest CHF 0.50, halves up.
